limits: Over 200 million 2024 platform views of videos related to video essays are playback events, not distinct persons, unique essays, genre market value or creator wages.
The BFI selected poll is 47 expert voters' favorites, with overlapping platform publication and international works, not all YouTube uploaders or videos.
An average video runtime of 36 minutes for nominated YouTube uploads is not average viewer session length, typical scripting time or global video duration.
The 70%+ external support-link statistic applies only to the curated subset of YouTube-published video essays and does not prove any paid patron conversion.
YouTube and Vimeo selected work counts are not disjoint genre populations and cannot be added to the platform's annual view event count.
An authored essay is thesis-driven or interpretive; documentaries, compilations, review and educational explanation may overlap and need transparent content coding.
No monthly publishing cadence or actual earnings distribution is observed in either source; avoid turning exceptional nominees into representative creators.
Nonexclusive selected nominations in BFI poll cannot be interpreted as a probability sample or unbiased share of all published YouTube video essays.

frame_3.outlet: British Film Institute, Sight and Sound
frame_3.population: Expert invited voters from film scholarship, gallery/festival curation, social media and YouTube; not a platform-wide sample
limits: 255 is the BFI poll's reported count of works mentioned in 2025, not 255 representative YouTube videos or verified unique online uploads.
Academic, exhibition and YouTube social communities use different selection, availability and discovery norms; do not equate their nominations with platform audience shares.
The 2024 BFI invited poll and 2025 poll differ in voter roster and curation; 183 versus 255 cannot measure growth in YouTube video-essay supply.
The work may appear on YouTube, Vimeo, in museums, cinema or remain inaccessible online; exhibition is not an online view event.
No production budgets, usual video runtimes for 2025 YouTube nominees, pay conversion, mean income or global watch-time measures were disclosed in this summary.
